description: DLS full sweep — 1M wiki-en-768. Builds the index from scratch (delete → create → ingest → force-merge → refresh), then runs all 11 DLS user personas × 2 sweeps. Ordered least → most restrictive: unrestricted(~100%) → role-group(~64%) → group-only(~40%) → group-name(~40%) → role-only(~32%) → name-only(~10%) → classified(~6%) → ultrastrict(~1%) → ultrastrict-narrow(~1%) → ultrastrict-micro(~0.6%) → ultrastrict-fixed(5k fixed). Self-contained: no prior index needed.
